dek: The second version of jodriscoll.com: an Angular 13 single-page portfolio on Cloudflare Pages, with every word of copy in ngx-translate files, an Angular service worker for offline loads, Bootstrap 4, SCSS, Animate on Scroll motion and Karma unit tests.
short: The second version of my portfolio: jodriscoll.com as an Angular 13 single-page app on Cloudflare Pages, with every word of copy in ngx-translate files, a service worker, Bootstrap 4, Animate on Scroll motion and Karma tests.

delivery.summary: Cloudflare Pages built the site straight from GitHub. A push to master shipped production; any other branch got its own preview URL.

steps.name: Push
steps.detail: Commits to the GitHub repository started a Cloudflare Pages build.

steps.name: Build
steps.detail: ng build --configuration production, run by Cloudflare Pages.

steps.name: Preview
steps.detail: Feature branches deployed to their own pages.dev URLs, such as the locomotive-scroll experiments.

steps.name: Production
steps.detail: master deployed to jodriscoll.com, a custom domain on the Pages project.

highlights.title: Copy out of the templates
highlights.text: Every word lived in an ngx-translate en.json file, so text changes never touched a component.

highlights.title: Offline loads
highlights.text: The Angular service worker cached the app shell, so repeat visits opened without the network.

highlights.title: Preview per branch
highlights.text: Cloudflare Pages gave each branch its own URL, which is how motion experiments were reviewed before they reached master.

images.alt: jodriscoll.com version 2: the Angular portfolio home page, introducing Joseph O'Driscoll over a soft portrait
